verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own materials say it offers automations, including 'Enhanced automations' on paid plans, and RSS campaigns send on their own schedule, so background sending is a documented, recurring behavior rather than a one-off action. The evidence is only marketing-level mentions, with no docs on how automations are built, triggered or run. missing for 10: documentation of building automation workflows (triggers, steps, conditions), evidence of AI- or agent-driven autonomous operation, hands-on or independent confirmation that automations run reliably in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Drive revenue with intuitive marketing analytics, automations, and AI tools.
For RSS Campaigns, the campaign will send according to its schedule.
sends targeted and event-driven messages via the API or SMTP
